ValidationRule.description: SAP and CFIN Street Character Limit
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $User.Alias<> "sconn",
OR( AND( LEN(BillingStreet) > 35, OR( $RecordType.Name = "SAP Germany", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Montreal", $RecordType.Name = "SAP NA Salem/MIA", $RecordType.Name = "SAP Asia", $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder" ) ),
AND( LEN(BillingStreet) > 60, $RecordType.Name = "S4 - Boulder" ),
AND( LEN(BillingStreet) > 250, $RecordType.Name = "Ax Billerica" ),
AND( LEN(BillingStreet) > 86, $RecordType.Name = "QAD - LDGI" ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Street field for SAP/CFIN must be 35 characters or less; Please break down the address in fields "Address 1", 2, 3 if more space is required.
